svg.text: Inside one theater: the additive eye and the multiplicative eye
One Θ±ell NF-Hodge theater is two species glued along their labels. The Θ±ell side sees a label t with its sign and turns the labels by addition; the ΘNF side sees only j = |t| and
turns them by multiplication. Neither symmetry is visible from the other side.
at (0,0) · universe #1 · every strip here lies in the ring structure of †: hatched near 45°, tilted by the sign of its label
Θ̲_v at the label j: q̲^(j²)
outline only: a type, not a set
Every chip names a data type of the toolkit (species ids of `iut species`, C structs of src/iut.h). All numbers are read from `iut walk`.
